hand.tileIdentityBinding: players[seat].hand[index] only for local owner or revealed state
hand.render: uniform source scale; rotate entire raster clockwise by seat; never mirror

wall.note: Flat 2D face-down stack construction from accepted back texture; no new perspective tile or new painted wall art. Absent stack/layer must not be drawn; no hardcoded 136/144 tile rule.

discardGrid.order: oldest to newest in server array, local columns then rows
discardGrid.overflow: Use continuation page/row reflow from client; never overlap or shrink glyphs below stated tile size.

meldStrip.arrange: center groups along local x; size driven by tiles and called placement

open-kong.input: 4 same tile ids, calledIndex 0..3 and fromSeat

added-kong.input: accepted triplet plus fourth of same id
added-kong.extraTile: same identity, same orientation as called tile, over called tile

concealed-kong.input: four same tile ids, visibility policy from rules/server

meldStrip.calledSlotBinding: server validated calledIndex/fromSeat; do not infer legality from art
meldStrip.drawOrder: base tiles left to right, then added-kong top tile

statusLayer.avatarMask: native circular clip inside frame; do not alter source pixels
statusLayer.windBadgeSkin: ready-hand-badge (blank jade disk reused with wind text, not a listening rule)
statusLayer.coexistPlacement: outside avatar at(-83,0) and(+83,0), labels beneath their own icons; never overlap or merge

candidateChoice.excessGroups: scroll or page, do not compress glyphs

readyHand.wrapOrScroll: page after 4, never stretch or cover glyphs
